content:
Let \(M\) be the initial number of men.

Total work:
\[
W=\frac74 \times M \times 8 \times 33 = 462M
\]

Remaining work:
\[
\frac37 W = \frac37 \times 462M = 198M
\]

This must equal the work done by \(M+81\) men working 9 hours/day for 13 days:
\[
198M = (M+81)\times 9 \times 13
\]
\[
198M = 117(M+81)
\]
\[
198M = 117M + 9477
\]
\[
81M = 9477
\]
\[
M = 117
\]

\boxed{117}
